    18→
    19→### 1. 启动 IM 服务
    20→
    21→```bash
    22→cd <repo>
    23→PYTHONPATH=src python -m uvicorn IM.app:app \
    24→  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8011
    25→```
    26→

    29→- `http://127.0.0.1:8011/chat`：直接进入聊天页
    30→
    31→你会看到的 ready 信号：
    32→- 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/` 时，页面会进入 Web IM，而不是要求你先知道前端 dev server。

    35→### 2. 准备最小 Gateway 配置
    36→
    37→```yaml
    38→node:
    39→  node_id: my-macbook
    40→
    41→agents:
    42→  - agent_id: assistant
    43→    title: My Assistant
    44→
    45→channels:
    46→  - name: web_relay
    47→    enabled: true
    48→
    49→kernel:
    50→  command: "python -m uvicorn personal_assistant.kernel_app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
    51→
    52→im_service:
    53→  url: http://<im-host>:8011
    54→```
    55→
    56→说明：
    57→- `im_service.url` 应填写 Gateway 实际要连接的 IM 服务地址；可以是本机，也可以是远端内网/公网地址。
    58→- 临时覆盖某次启动的 IM 地址时，可在命令行追加 `--im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011`。
    59→- 默认本地路径不需要手工填写 `kernel.token`；Gateway 会补齐本地 kernel bearer token。
    60→- 省略 `agents[].workspace_root` 时，默认使用 `~/nano-assistant/workspace/<agent_id>/`，并在首次加载配置时自动创建目录。
    61→- `kernel.base_url` 属于 Gateway 内部默认值，面向用户的最小配置无需填写。
    62→
    63→### 3. 启动 Gateway
    64→
    65→```bash
    66→cd <repo>
    67→PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main
    68→# 或显式指定远端 IM
    69→PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
    70→```
    71→
    72→默认命令会把 Gateway 放到后台，并立即返回：
    73→
    74→```text
    75→STARTED pid=<pid> health_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/health log=<config目录>/gateway.log
    76→```
    77→
    78→启动后的预期行为：
    79→- 未绑定节点：Gateway 会把 `ACTION ...` / `NEXT ...` 写入 `gateway.log`，并尝试打开绑定页；默认绑定页位于 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/bind/confirm?token=...`。
    80→- 已绑定节点：Gateway 保持后台运行，等待 Web IM 消息。
    81→- 启动失败或 IM bootstrap 失败：Gateway 会输出明确的 `ERROR ...` / `NEXT ...`；同样的可执行提示会回写到 IM 节点板 `last_error`。
    82→
    83→停止当前配置对应的后台 Gateway：
    84→
    85→```bash
    86→PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main stop
    87→```
    88→
    89→重启（stop + start）：
    90→
    91→```bash
    92→PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart
    93→# 或显式指定远端 IM
    94→PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
    95→```
    96→
    97→**单实例保护**：同一台机器只允许运行一个 Gateway 实例。若已有实例在运行，`start`/`restart` 会拒绝启动并提示当前 PID：
    98→
    99→```text
   100→ERROR gateway already running (pid=<pid>). Run `stop` first or `restart` to replace it.
   101→```
   102→
   103→stop 反馈语义：
   104→- `STOPPED ...`：后台 Gateway 已关闭；若优雅等待超时会额外显示 `forced=true`。
   105→- `NOT RUNNING ...`：没有可用运行态记录，可直接重新 start。
   106→- `STALE ...`：记录里的 pid 已失效；CLI 会自动清掉陈旧状态文件，然后你可以重新 start。
   107→
   108→你会看到的 ready 信号：
   109→- 默认路径下，终端先打印 `STARTED ...` 并返回；随后可查看 `gateway.log` 或 Web IM/绑定页确认 Gateway 已 ready。
   110→- 若使用 `--foreground` 调试路径，终端会保持常驻，并直接显示 `ACTION ...` / `NEXT ...`。
   111→- 如果终端打印 `ERROR ...` / `NEXT ...`，不要先翻代码；直接按 `NEXT` 的动作处理即可。
   112→
   113→### 4. 进入 Web IM 并发起聊天
   114→
   115→- 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/`。IM host 会提供 Web IM 壳，并在浏览器里落到 `/chat`。
   116→- Web IM 会自动准备本地 `You` 用户和默认 starter conversation；正常用户不需要手工创建用户、会话或拼 `message` API。
   117→- 如果未绑定，composer 会直接禁用，并显示统一的 `Chat unavailable` 卡片，提示先完成 Gateway 绑定。
   118→- 如果已绑定但 Gateway 离线，composer 仍会保持禁用，并显示同一套 `Chat unavailable` 卡片，明确要求 bring the node online or bind another online node。
   119→- 如果页面已可发送但目标节点在提交瞬间不可用，发送区会保留草稿，并显示同样的 `Chat unavailable` 失败提示；用户无需查看终端日志即可理解问题。
   120→- 如果刚完成绑定，刷新 `/` 或重新打开 `/chat` 即可开始聊天。
   121→
   122→到这里你只需要按页面提示判断下一步：
   123→- 看到可输入的 composer：可以直接发第一条消息。
   124→- 看到 `Chat unavailable` + `Next: Open bind flow`：先完成绑定。
   125→- 看到 `Chat unavailable` + `Next: Bring Gateway online`：先把 Gateway 恢复到在线状态。
   126→
   127→更完整的启动、状态说明与调试附录见 `docs/operator-runbook.md`。前端开发模式、Mock/真实 IM 边界见 `src/IM/frontend/README.md`。
   128→
   129→## CLI
   130→
   131→### Start CLI (interactive REPL)
   132→
   133→Managed mode (CLI starts/stops local API automatically):
   134→
   135→```bash
   136→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main \
   137→  --mode managed \
   138→  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
   139→  --token test-token
   140→```
   141→
   142→Managed mode can inject LLM runtime config into the managed API process:
   143→
   144→```bash
   145→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main \
   146→  --mode managed \
   147→  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
   148→  --token test-token \
   149→  --llm-provider anthropic \
   150→  --llm-model claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 \
   151→  --llm-base-url http://127.0.0.1:4100 \
   152→  --llm-api-key <key> \
   153→  --llm-timeout-seconds 60
   154→```
   155→
   156→`managed` mode uses a higher default API timeout (`120s`) to reduce false timeouts during real agent turns. Override with `--api-timeout-seconds`.
   157→
   158→Remote mode (connect existing API, never starts local process):
   159→
   160→```bash
   161→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main \
   162→  --mode remote \
   163→  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
   164→  --token test-token
   165→```
   166→
   167→If you are not using editable install, run with `PYTHONPATH=src`:
   168→
   169→```bash
   170→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token
   171→```
   172→
   173→### REPL commands
   174→
   175→- `/help`
   176→- `/new`
   177→- `/use <session_id>`
   178→- `/session`
   179→- `/tools`
   180→- `/compact`
   181→- `/history [n]`
   182→- `/exit`
   183→
   184→### CLI module boundary
   185→
   186→- `main.py`: 仅负责 CLI 进程入口（调用 `run_cli`）。
   187→- `commands.py`: 稳定入口编排层（参数解析、模式决策、REPL 主循环、错误分层）。
   188→- `repl_input.py`: 可编辑输入与历史回填实现（行内编辑、方向键、草稿恢复）。
   189→- `repl_commands.py`: REPL 斜杠命令路由与参数校验（`/help /new /use ...`）。
   190→- `http_client.py`: 唯一 HTTP 边界（CLI 不直接依赖 runtime/tool/session/llm 内核实现）。
   191→
   192→开发约定（收口门禁）：
   193→
   194→- 保持 HTTP-only：CLI 只能通过 `ServerClient` 访问 API。
   195→- 避免空转发层：不要在 `commands.py` 里重新导出 `repl_input/repl_commands` 的内部实现。
   196→- 保持脚本机读稳定：非交互子命令 stdout 必须输出 single final JSON object on stdout。
   197→
   198→Interactive input ergonomics:
   199→
   200→- inline editing with `←/→` + Backspace
   201→- history recall with `↑/↓` (session-scoped), and draft restore when navigating back down
   202→- type `/` to open command dropdown, use `↑/↓` to switch, press `Enter` to fill selected command
   203→
   204→REPL will also print session context budget after each message turn and after `/compact`:
   205→
   206→- `Context budget: <used>/<max> (<ratio>%)`
   207→- `Context budget (after /compact): <used>/<max> (<ratio>%)`
   208→- threshold hints at `>=70%`, `>=85%`, `>=95%` to suggest compaction timing
   209→- budget fetch failures are fail-open (`Context budget: unavailable ...`) and do not interrupt chat flow
   210→
   211→Error output is layered and actionable:
   212→
   213→- REPL errors include `Layer: input|network|runtime` plus `Suggestion`
   214→- non-interactive command failures keep JSON shape and include `layer`, e.g. `{"error":"...","layer":"network","suggestion":"..."}`.
   215→
   216→### Release observability helpers
   217→
   218→Use `release_observability` to translate perf snapshots into actionable diagnostics:
   219→
   220→```bash
   221→PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
   222→from coding_cli.release_observability import summarize_perf_metrics, build_guardrail_hints
   223→
   224→metrics = {
   225→    "batches": 3,
   226→    "polled_events": 120,
   227→    "consumed_events": 96,
   228→    "preview_emitted": 12,
   229→    "run_filtered": 18,
   230→    "dedupe_dropped": 6,
   231→    "throughput_ratio": 0.8,
   232→    "redraw_ratio": 0.125,
   233→    "sample_ready": True,
   234→    "throughput_ok": True,
   235→    "redraw_ratio_ok": True,
   236→    "stable": True,
   237→    "guardrail_reason": "ok",
   238→}
   239→print("\n".join(summarize_perf_metrics(metrics)))
   240→print("\n".join(build_guardrail_hints(metrics)))
   241→PY
   242→```
   243→
   244→### Release acceptance & rollback playbook
   245→
   246→Render release steps without executing them:
   247→
   248→```bash
   249→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.release_playbook \
   250→  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8003 \
   251→  --token test-token
   252→```
   253→
   254→Execute acceptance steps (CLI gate + managed smoke):
   255→
   256→```bash
   257→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.release_playbook \
   258→  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8003 \
   259→  --token test-token \
   260→  --execute
   261→```
   262→
   263→Playbook output is JSON and includes:
   264→
   265→- `acceptance_steps`: required pre-release checks.
   266→- `rollback_steps`: rollback command template list.
   267→- `status`: `pending` / `passed` / `failed`.
   268→- `execution`: per-step return code and captured stdout/stderr when `--execute` is set.
   269→
   270→### Non-interactive commands
   271→
   272→```bash
   273→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token health
   274→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token create-session --title "demo"
   275→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token send-message --session-id <session_id> --text "hello"
   276→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token llm-config get
   277→PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m coding_cli.main --mode remote --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --token test-token llm-config set --provider anthropic --model claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022 --base-url http://127.0.0.1:4100 --timeout-seconds 60
   278→```
   279→
   280→### Environment variables
   281→
   282→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_CLI_MODE` (`managed` or `remote`, default `remote`)
   283→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_API_BASE_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`)
   284→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_API_TOKEN` (required for protected endpoints)
   285→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_REQUEST_ID` (optional)
   286→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_SESSION_ID` (optional default session for `send-message` and REPL startup)
   287→- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (default `30`)
   288→- `--api-timeout-seconds <float>` (CLI override for current run)
   289→- managed startup LLM overrides: `--llm-provider`, `--llm-model`, `--llm-base-url`, `--llm-api-key`, `--llm-timeout-seconds`
   290→
   291→### Troubleshooting
   292→
   293→If your shell has `http_proxy`/`https_proxy` set, local API calls to `127.0.0.1` may fail via proxy.
   294→For this CLI, localhost/127.0.0.1 is automatically treated as direct connection.
   295→If needed, also set:
   296→
   297→```bash
   298→export NO_PROXY=127.0.0.1,localhost
   299→```
   300→
   301→Common mode-specific diagnostics:
   302→
   303→- `managed` + `port ... already in use`:
   304→  - Free the port, use another local `--base-url` port, or switch to `--mode remote`.
   305→- `managed` + startup timeout / startup failed:
   306→  - Check local uvicorn/python environment and startup logs, then retry.
   307→- `remote` + `connection refused`:
   308→  - Verify `--base-url` points to a running remote API and that the endpoint is reachable from your machine.

content.text:
# nano-multiagent

## Quick start
```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Start Here: 先启动 IM，再启动 Gateway，然后打开聊天

默认用户路径只需要一条链路：先启动 IM 服务，再启动 Gateway；如果浏览器出现绑定页就完成绑定；最后回到 Web IM 发起第一条聊天消息。

首次启动时，你只需要关心三件事：
- IM 是否已经可打开：浏览器访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/` 能进入聊天入口。
- Gateway 是否已经 ready：终端出现绑定下一步，或保持常驻等待消息。
- 接下来该做什么：未绑定就完成绑定；已绑定就直接聊天。

### 1. 启动 IM 服务

```bash
cd <repo>
PYTHONPATH=src python -m uvicorn IM.app:app \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8011
```

默认 Web IM 入口：
- `http://127.0.0.1:8011/`：推荐入口
- `http://127.0.0.1:8011/chat`：直接进入聊天页

你会看到的 ready 信号：
- 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/` 时，页面会进入 Web IM，而不是要求你先知道前端 dev server。
- 如果仓内已带 `src/IM/frontend/dist`，IM host 会直接服务 `/`、`/chat`、`/settings/*`、`/bind/confirm`。

### 2. 准备最小 Gateway 配置

```yaml
node:
  node_id: my-macbook

agents:
  - agent_id: assistant
    title: My Assistant

channels:
  - name: web_relay
    enabled: true

kernel:
  command: "python -m uvicorn personal_assistant.kernel_app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"

im_service:
  url: http://<im-host>:8011
```

说明：
- `im_service.url` 应填写 Gateway 实际要连接的 IM 服务地址；可以是本机，也可以是远端内网/公网地址。
- 临时覆盖某次启动的 IM 地址时，可在命令行追加 `--im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011`。
- 默认本地路径不需要手工填写 `kernel.token`；Gateway 会补齐本地 kernel bearer token。
- 省略 `agents[].workspace_root` 时，默认使用 `~/nano-assistant/workspace/<agent_id>/`，并在首次加载配置时自动创建目录。
- `kernel.base_url` 属于 Gateway 内部默认值，面向用户的最小配置无需填写。

### 3. 启动 Gateway

```bash
cd <repo>
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main
# 或显式指定远端 IM
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
```

默认命令会把 Gateway 放到后台，并立即返回：

```text
STARTED pid=<pid> health_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/health log=<config目录>/gateway.log
```

启动后的预期行为：
- 未绑定节点：Gateway 会把 `ACTION ...` / `NEXT ...` 写入 `gateway.log`，并尝试打开绑定页；默认绑定页位于 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/bind/confirm?token=...`。
- 已绑定节点：Gateway 保持后台运行，等待 Web IM 消息。
- 启动失败或 IM bootstrap 失败：Gateway 会输出明确的 `ERROR ...` / `NEXT ...`；同样的可执行提示会回写到 IM 节点板 `last_error`。

停止当前配置对应的后台 Gateway：

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main stop
```

重启（stop + start）：

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart
# 或显式指定远端 IM
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
```

**单实例保护**：同一台机器只允许运行一个 Gateway 实例。若已有实例在运行，`start`/`restart` 会拒绝启动并提示当前 PID：

```text
ERROR gateway already running (pid=<pid>). Run `stop` first or `restart` to replace it.
```

stop 反馈语义：
- `STOPPED ...`：后台 Gateway 已关闭；若优雅等待超时会额外显示 `forced=true`。
- `NOT RUNNING ...`：没有可用运行态记录，可直接重新 start。
- `STALE ...`：记录里的 pid 已失效；CLI 会自动清掉陈旧状态文件，然后你可以重新 start。

你会看到的 ready 信号：
- 默认路径下，终端先打印 `STARTED ...` 并返回；随后可查看 `gateway.log` 或 Web IM/绑定页确认 Gateway 已 ready。
- 若使用 `--foreground` 调试路径，终端会保持常驻，并直接显示 `ACTION ...` / `NEXT ...`。
- 如果终端打印 `ERROR ...` / `NEXT ...`，不要先翻代码；直接按 `NEXT` 的动作处理即可。

### 4. 进入 Web IM 并发起聊天

- 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/`。IM host 会提供 Web IM 壳，并在浏览器里落到 `/chat`。
- Web IM 会自动准备本地 `You` 用户和默认 starter conversation；正常用户不需要手工创建用户、会话或拼 `message` API。


Remote mode (connect existing API, never starts local process):

```bash

  --mode remote \

  --token test-token

```

- `/new`
- `/use <session_id>`
- `/session`
- `/tools`
- `/compact`
- `/history [n]`
- `/exit`

- `commands.py`: 稳定入口编排层（参数解析、模式决策、REPL 主循环、错误分层）。
- `repl_input.py`: 可编辑输入与历史回填实现（行内编辑、方向键、草稿恢复）。
- `repl_commands.py`: REPL 斜杠命令路由与参数校验（`/help /new /use ...`）。
- `http_client.py`: 唯一 HTTP 边界（CLI 不直接依赖 runtime/tool/session/llm 内核实现）。

### Environment variables

- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_CLI_MODE` (`managed` or `remote`, default `remote`)
- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_API_BASE_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`)
- `NANO_MULTIAGENT_API_TOKEN` (required for protected endpoints)

首次启动时，你只需要关心三件事：
- IM 是否已经可打开：浏览器访问 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/` 能进入聊天入口。
- Gateway 是否已经 ready：终端出现绑定下一步，或保持常驻等待消息。
- 接下来该做什么：未绑定就完成绑定；已绑定就直接聊天。

### 1. 启动 IM 服务

```bash
cd <repo>
PYTHONPATH=src python -m uvicorn IM.app:app \
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8011
```

默认 Web IM 入口：
- `http://127.0.0.1:8011/`：推荐入口
- `http://127.0.0.1:8011/chat`：直接进入聊天页

你会看到的 ready 信号：
- 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/` 时，页面会进入 Web IM，而不是要求你先知道前端 dev server。
- 如果仓内已带 `src/IM/frontend/dist`，IM host 会直接服务 `/`、`/chat`、`/settings/*`、`/bind/confirm`。

### 2. 准备最小 Gateway 配置

```yaml
node:
  node_id: my-macbook

agents:
  - agent_id: assistant
    title: My Assistant

channels:
  - name: web_relay
    enabled: true

kernel:
  command: "python -m uvicorn personal_assistant.kernel_app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"

im_service:
  url: http://<im-host>:8011
```

说明：
- `im_service.url` 应填写 Gateway 实际要连接的 IM 服务地址；可以是本机，也可以是远端内网/公网地址。
- 临时覆盖某次启动的 IM 地址时，可在命令行追加 `--im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011`。
- 默认本地路径不需要手工填写 `kernel.token`；Gateway 会补齐本地 kernel bearer token。
- 省略 `agents[].workspace_root` 时，默认使用 `~/nano-assistant/workspace/<agent_id>/`，并在首次加载配置时自动创建目录。
- `kernel.base_url` 属于 Gateway 内部默认值，面向用户的最小配置无需填写。

### 3. 启动 Gateway

```bash
cd <repo>
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main
# 或显式指定远端 IM
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
```

默认命令会把 Gateway 放到后台，并立即返回：

```text
STARTED pid=<pid> health_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/health log=<config目录>/gateway.log
```

启动后的预期行为：
- 未绑定节点：Gateway 会把 `ACTION ...` / `NEXT ...` 写入 `gateway.log`，并尝试打开绑定页；默认绑定页位于 `http://127.0.0.1:8011/bind/confirm?token=...`。
- 已绑定节点：Gateway 保持后台运行，等待 Web IM 消息。
- 启动失败或 IM bootstrap 失败：Gateway 会输出明确的 `ERROR ...` / `NEXT ...`；同样的可执行提示会回写到 IM 节点板 `last_error`。

停止当前配置对应的后台 Gateway：

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main stop
```

重启（stop + start）：

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart
# 或显式指定远端 IM
PYTHONPATH=src python -m personal_assistant.main restart --im-service-url http://<im-host>:8011
```

**单实例保护**：同一台机器只允许运行一个 Gateway 实例。若已有实例在运行，`start`/`restart` 会拒绝启动并提示当前 PID：

```text
ERROR gateway already running (pid=<pid>). Run `stop` first or `restart` to replace it.
```

- `STOPPED ...`：后台 Gateway 已关闭；若优雅等待超时会额外显示 `forced=true`。
- `NOT RUNNING ...`：没有可用运行态记录，可直接重新 start。
- `STALE ...`：记录里的 pid 已失效；CLI 会自动清掉陈旧状态文件，然后你可以重新 start。

   461→class _IMBootstrapClient:
   462→    """Query IM ownership state and launch browser binding when a node is unbound.

   474→    def __init__(
   475→        self,
   476→        *,
   477→        base_url: str,
   478→        token: str | None,
   479→        client: httpx.Client | None = None,
   480→        client_factory: BootstrapClientFactory | None = None,
   481→        browser_opener: BrowserOpener = webbrowser.open,
   482→        feedback_sink: FeedbackSink = _emit_gateway_feedback,
   483→        timeout_seconds: float = 5.0,
   484→        monotonic: Monotonic = time.monotonic,
   485→        sleep: Sleep = time.sleep,
   486→    ) -> None:
   487→        self._base_urls = _im_bootstrap_base_urls(base_url)
   488→        self._base_headers = _im_http_headers(token)
   489→        self._timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
   490→        self._client_factory = client_factory
   491→        self._clients: dict[str, httpx.Client] = {}
   492→        self._base_url = self._base_urls[0]
   493→        if client is not None:
   494→            self._clients[self._base_url] = client
   495→        self._browser_opener = browser_opener
   496→        self._feedback_sink = feedback_sink
   497→        self._monotonic = monotonic
   498→        self._sleep = sleep

   500→    def ensure_node_binding(self, *, node_id: str) -> str | None:
   501→        """Open the bind URL when the upstream node still has no owner.
   502→
   503→        Args:
   504→            node_id: Gateway node id that was just registered over IM websocket.
   505→
   506→        Returns:
   507→            The opened bind URL for unbound nodes, or `None` when the node is already owned.
   508→
   509→        Raises:
   510→            RuntimeError: When IM bootstrap APIs do not expose the registered node.
   511→        """
   512→
   513→        owner_id, resolved_base_url = self._wait_for_owner(node_id=node_id)
   514→        if owner_id:
   515→            return None
   516→        client = self._get_client(resolved_base_url)
   517→        try:
   518→            response = client.post("/im/v1/bind", json={"action": "start", "node_id": node_id})
   519→            response.raise_for_status()
   520→        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
   521→            raise GatewayStartupError(
   522→                summary=f"node {node_id} could not start IM binding",
   523→                next_step=f"Verify {resolved_base_url}/im/v1/bind is reachable, then rerun gateway.",
   524→            ) from exc
   525→        payload = response.json()
   526→        bind_url = _require_text(payload.get("bind_url"), field_name="bind_url")
   527→        self._browser_opener(bind_url, new=2, autoraise=True)
   528→        self._feedback_sink(
   529→            "ACTION",
   530→            f"node {node_id} is waiting for IM binding",
   531→            f"Open {bind_url} to finish binding this node.",
   532→        )
   533→        return bind_url
   534→
   535→    def close(self) -> None:
   536→        """Release the owned HTTP client."""
   537→
   538→        seen_ids: set[int] = set()
   539→        for client in self._clients.values():
   540→            client_id = id(client)
   541→            if client_id in seen_ids:
   542→                continue
   543→            seen_ids.add(client_id)
   544→            client.close()
   545→
   546→    def _wait_for_owner(self, *, node_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
   547→        deadline = self._monotonic() + 5.0
   548→        last_error: Exception | None = None
   549→        while self._monotonic() <= deadline:
   550→            for base_url in self._base_urls:
   551→                try:
   552→                    return self._get_owner_id(node_id=node_id, base_url=base_url), base_url
   553→                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
   554→                    last_error = exc
   555→            self._sleep(0.1)
   556→        checked_urls = ", ".join(f"{base_url}/im/v1/nodes" for base_url in self._base_urls)
   557→        message = f"node {node_id} did not appear in IM bootstrap"
   558→        next_step = f"Verify the IM node API is reachable at {checked_urls} and rerun gateway."
   559→        if last_error is not None:
   560→            raise GatewayStartupError(summary=message, next_step=next_step) from last_error
   561→        raise GatewayStartupError(summary=message, next_step=next_step)
   562→
   563→    def _get_owner_id(self, *, node_id: str, base_url: str) -> str:
   564→        response = self._get_client(base_url).get("/im/v1/nodes")
   565→        response.raise_for_status()
   566→        payload = response.json()
   567→        if not isinstance(payload, list):
   568→            raise RuntimeError("nodes response must be a list")
   569→        for item in payload:
   570→            if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
   571→                continue
   572→            if _require_text(item.get("node_id"), field_name="node_id") != node_id:
   573→                continue
   574→            owner_id = item.get("owner_id")
   575→            return owner_id.strip() if isinstance(owner_id, str) else ""
   576→        raise RuntimeError(f"node {node_id} not found")
   577→
   578→    def _get_client(self, base_url: str) -> httpx.Client:
   579→        client = self._clients.get(base_url)
   580→        if client is not None:
   581→            return client
   582→        if self._client_factory is not None:
   583→            client = self._client_factory(base_url)
   584→        else:
   585→            client = httpx.Client(
   586→                base_url=base_url,
   587→                headers=self._base_headers,
   588→                timeout=self._timeout_seconds,
   589→                trust_env=False,
   590→            )
   591→        self._clients[base_url] = client
   592→        return client

   595→class GatewayProcessManager:
   596→    """Manage the local agent kernel child process for the gateway.
   597→
   598→    Args:
   599→        config: Kernel process and health-probe settings loaded from local config.
   600→        kernel_client: HTTP client used for readiness probes.
   601→        process_factory: Factory used to spawn the kernel child process.
   602→        monotonic: Monotonic clock source for timeout accounting.
   603→        sleep: Sleep function used between readiness probes.
   604→    """
   605→
   606→    def __init__(
   607→        self,
   608→        *,
   609→        config: KernelConfig,
   610→        kernel_client: KernelApiClient,
   611→        process_factory: ProcessFactory | None = None,
   612→        monotonic: Monotonic = time.monotonic,
   613→        sleep: Sleep = time.sleep,
   614→    ) -> None:
   615→        self._config = config
   616→        self._kernel_client = kernel_client
   617→        self._process_factory = process_factory or _spawn_process
   618→        self._monotonic = monotonic
   619→        self._sleep = sleep
   620→        self.process: ProcessLike | None = None
   621→
   622→    def start_kernel_process(self) -> ProcessLike:
   623→        """Spawn the local kernel child and wait until `/v1/health` reports ready.
   624→
   625→        Returns:
   626→            The spawned process handle once health probing succeeds.
   627→
   628→        Raises:
   629→            RuntimeError: When the kernel does not become healthy before timeout.
   630→
   631→        Side Effects:
   632→            Starts a subprocess and performs repeated HTTP health checks.
   633→        """
   634→
   635→        if self.process is not None:
   636→            return self.process
   637→        process = self._process_factory(self._config.command)
   638→        self.process = process
   639→        self._wait_for_health()
   640→        return process
   641→
   642→    def stop_kernel_process(self) -> None:
   643→        """Terminate the managed kernel child, escalating to kill when needed.
   644→
   645→        Side Effects:
   646→            Sends terminate/kill signals to the managed child process.
   647→        """
   648→
   649→        process = self.process
   650→        if process is None:
   651→            return
   652→        process.terminate()
   653→        try:
   654→            process.wait(timeout=self._config.shutdown_grace_seconds)
   655→        except (TimeoutError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
   656→            process.kill()
   657→        finally:
   658→            self.process = None
   659→
   660→    def _wait_for_health(self) -> None:
   661→        deadline = self._monotonic() + self._config.startup_timeout_seconds
   662→        last_error: Exception | None = None
   663→        while self._monotonic() <= deadline:
   664→            try:
   665→                payload = self._kernel_client.health()
   666→            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
   667→                last_error = exc
   668→            else:
   669→                if bool(payload.get("healthy")):
   670→                    return
   671→                last_error = RuntimeError(f"kernel reported unhealthy payload: {payload}")
   672→            self._sleep(self._config.health_poll_interval_seconds)
   673→        message = "kernel health check timed out"
   674→        if last_error is not None:
   675→            raise RuntimeError(message) from last_error
   676→        raise RuntimeError(message)

   679→class PollingHeartbeatRunner:
   680→    """Run the existing heartbeat scheduler as a background tick loop.
   681→
   682→    Args:
   683→        scheduler: Existing scheduler implementation that evaluates `HEARTBEAT.md`.
   684→        config: Local heartbeat runtime settings.
   685→        sleep: Async sleep function used between tick passes.
   686→
   687→    Notes:
   688→        The runner keeps scheduler semantics local and configuration-driven. It does not
   689→        introduce hot reload or remote orchestration; it only provides the missing long-
   690→        running process wrapper required to keep the gateway alive.
   691→    """
   692→
   693→    def __init__(
   694→        self,
   695→        *,
   696→        scheduler: HeartbeatScheduler,
   697→        config: HeartbeatConfig,
   698→        sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None]] = asyncio.sleep,
   699→    ) -> None:
   700→        self._scheduler = scheduler
   701→        self._config = config
   702→        self._sleep = sleep
   703→        self._stop_requested = False
   704→        self._wake_event = asyncio.Event()
   705→        self._task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
   706→        self._product_reports: list[dict[str, object]] = []
   707→
   708→    async def start(self) -> None:
   709→        """Start background scheduler ticking exactly once."""
   710→
   711→        if self._task is not None:
   712→            return
   713→        self._stop_requested = False
   714→        self._wake_event.clear()
   715→        self._task = asyncio.create_task(self._run_loop(), name="personal-assistant-heartbeat")
   716→
   717→    async def close(self) -> None:
   718→        """Stop the background loop and wait for the worker task to finish."""
   719→
   720→        task = self._task
   721→        if task is None:
   722→            return
   723→        self._stop_requested = True
   724→        self._wake_event.set()
   725→        await task
   726→        self._task = None
   727→
   728→    def request_tick(self) -> None:
   729→        """Wake the loop so a manual IM-triggered tick can run promptly."""
   730→
   731→        self._wake_event.set()
   732→
   733→    def build_product_reports(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
   734→        """Return heartbeat report payloads ready for IM publication.
   735→
   736→        Returns:
   737→            Newly accumulated heartbeat summaries and clears the local queue so the runtime
   738→            publishes each heartbeat result to IM at most once.
   739→        """
   740→        payloads = list(self._product_reports)
   741→        self._product_reports.clear()
   742→        return payloads
   743→
   744→    async def _run_loop(self) -> None:
   745→        while not self._stop_requested:
   746→            summary = self._scheduler.tick()
   747→            self._product_reports.extend(_build_heartbeat_product_reports(summary))
   748→            if self._stop_requested:
   749→                break
   750→            try:
   751→                await asyncio.wait_for(self._wake_event.wait(), timeout=self._config.tick_interval_seconds)
   752→            except TimeoutError:
   753→                continue
   754→            finally:
   755→                self._wake_event.clear()
   756→

   758→class _InboundDispatcher:
   759→    """Bridge synchronous channel callbacks onto the async inbound pipeline."""
   760→
   761→    def __init__(self, pipeline: InboundPipeline) -> None:
   762→        self._pipeline = pipeline
   763→        self._loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop | None = None
   764→
   765→    def bind_loop(self, loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
   766→        """Bind the runtime event loop used to execute inbound pipeline coroutines."""
   767→
   768→        self._loop = loop
   769→
   770→    def __call__(self, message: InboundMessage) -> None:
   771→        """Schedule one inbound message on the runtime loop.
   772→
   773→        Raises:
   774→            RuntimeError: When called before the runtime loop is available.
   775→        """
   776→
   777→        loop = self._loop
   778→        if loop is None:
   779→            raise RuntimeError("gateway runtime loop is not ready")
   780→        try:
   781→            running_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
   782→        except RuntimeError:
   783→            running_loop = None
   784→        if running_loop is loop:
   785→            task = loop.create_task(self._pipeline.handle_inbound(message))
   786→            task.add_done_callback(_consume_task_exception)
   787→            return
   788→        future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._pipeline.handle_inbound(message), loop)
   789→        future.add_done_callback(_consume_future_exception)

   792→class GatewayRuntime:
   793→    """Run the assembled Node Gateway process until shutdown is requested.
   794→
   795→    Args:
   796→        config: Parsed immutable local gateway config.
   797→        process_manager: Kernel child-process lifecycle manager.
   798→        channel_registry: Registry containing configured channel adapters.
   799→        heartbeat_runner: Background heartbeat loop wrapper.
   800→        im_connection_manager: Optional IM websocket connector.
   801→        on_inbound: Shared synchronous inbound callback given to channel adapters.

   803→        resource_closers: Additional cleanup callables invoked after runtime shutdown.
   804→    """
   805→
   806→    def __init__(
   807→        self,
   808→        config: LocalConfig,
   809→        process_manager: GatewayProcessManager,
   810→        *,
   811→        channel_registry: ChannelRegistry | None = None,
   812→        heartbeat_runner: HeartbeatRunner | None = None,
   813→        im_connection_manager: IMConnectionManagerLike | None = None,
   814→        on_inbound: Callable[[InboundMessage], None] | None = None,
   815→        post_im_connect: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
   816→        resource_closers: tuple[Callable[[], None], ...] = (),
   817→        feedback_sink: FeedbackSink = _emit_gateway_feedback,
   818→        internal_dispatch_handler: InternalDispatchHandler | None = None,
   819→        gateway_internal_port: int = 8089,
   820→    ) -> None:
   821→        self._config = config
   822→        self._process_manager = process_manager
   823→        self._channel_registry = channel_registry or ChannelRegistry()
   824→        self._heartbeat_runner = heartbeat_runner
   825→        self._im_connection_manager = im_connection_manager
   826→        self._on_inbound = on_inbound or (lambda _message: None)
   827→        self._post_im_connect = post_im_connect
   828→        self._resource_closers = resource_closers
   829→        self._feedback_sink = feedback_sink
   830→        self._internal_dispatch_handler = internal_dispatch_handler
   831→        self._gateway_internal_port = gateway_internal_port
   832→        self._ready_event = threading.Event()
   833→        self._shutdown_requested = threading.Event()
   834→
   835→    def wait_until_ready(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool:
   836→        """Block until the runtime reaches ready state or timeout expires."""
   837→
   838→        return self._ready_event.wait(timeout)
   839→
   840→    def request_shutdown(self) -> None:
   841→        """Request graceful shutdown from another thread or signal handler."""
   842→
   843→        self._shutdown_requested.set()
   844→
   845→    def run_forever(self) -> int:
   846→        """Run the gateway until shutdown is requested.
   847→
   848→        Returns:
   849→            `0` after startup succeeds and graceful shutdown completes.
   850→        """
   851→
   852→        self._ready_event.clear()
   853→        self._shutdown_requested.clear()
   854→        return asyncio.run(self._run_until_shutdown())
   855→
   856→    async def _run_until_shutdown(self) -> int:
   857→        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
   858→        if isinstance(self._on_inbound, _InboundDispatcher):
   859→            self._on_inbound.bind_loop(loop)
   860→
   861→        channels_started = False
   862→        heartbeat_started = False
   863→        im_connected = False
   864→        dispatch_runner: Any | None = None
   865→        im_task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
   866→        try:
   867→            self._process_manager.start_kernel_process()
   868→            start_channels(self._channel_registry, self._on_inbound)
   869→            channels_started = True
   870→            if self._heartbeat_runner is not None:
   871→                await self._heartbeat_runner.start()
   872→                heartbeat_started = True
   873→            if self._internal_dispatch_handler is not None:
   874→                try:
   875→                    from aiohttp import web as _aiohttp_web
   876→                    _dispatch_app = _aiohttp_web.Application()
   877→                    _dispatch_app.router.add_post(
   878→                        "/internal/dispatch",
   879→                        self._internal_dispatch_handler.build_aiohttp_handler(),
   880→                    )
   881→                    dispatch_runner = _aiohttp_web.AppRunner(_dispatch_app)
   882→                    await dispatch_runner.setup()
   883→                    _dispatch_site = _aiohttp_web.TCPSite(
   884→                        dispatch_runner, "127.0.0.1", self._gateway_internal_port
   885→                    )
   886→                    await _dispatch_site.start()
   887→                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
   888→                    dispatch_runner = None
   889→            self._ready_event.set()
   890→            if self._im_connection_manager is not None:
   891→                await self._im_connection_manager.connect_once()
   892→                im_connected = True
   893→                if self._post_im_connect is not None:
   894→                    try:
   895→                        await asyncio.to_thread(self._post_im_connect)
   896→                    except GatewayStartupError as exc:
   897→                        await self._publish_startup_failure(exc)
   898→                        raise
   899→                await self._publish_heartbeat_product_reports()
   900→                im_task = asyncio.create_task(self._im_connection_manager.run_forever(), name="personal-assistant-im")
   901→            await asyncio.to_thread(self._shutdown_requested.wait)
   902→            await self._publish_heartbeat_product_reports()
   903→            return 0
   904→        finally:
   905→            self._ready_event.clear()
   906→            if dispatch_runner is not None:
   907→                with suppress(Exception):
   908→                    await dispatch_runner.cleanup()
   909→            if heartbeat_started and self._heartbeat_runner is not None:
   910→                await self._heartbeat_runner.close()
   911→            if channels_started:
   912→                stop_channels(self._channel_registry)
   913→            if im_connected and self._im_connection_manager is not None:
   914→                await self._im_connection_manager.close()
   915→                if im_task is not None:
   916→                    await _await_background_task(im_task)
   917→            elif im_task is not None:
   918→                im_task.cancel()
   919→                with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
   920→                    await im_task
   921→            self._process_manager.stop_kernel_process()
   922→            for closer in self._resource_closers:
   923→                closer()
   924→
   925→    async def _publish_startup_failure(self, exc: GatewayStartupError) -> None:
   926→        self._feedback_sink("ERROR", exc.summary, exc.next_step)
   927→        manager = self._im_connection_manager
   928→        if manager is None or not manager.connected:
   929→            return
   930→        last_error = exc.summary if exc.next_step is None else f"{exc.summary} Next: {exc.next_step}"
   931→        payload = {
   932→            "node_id": self._config.node.node_id,
   933→            "status": "degraded",
   934→            "agent_count": len(self._config.agents),
   935→            "last_error": last_error,
   936→        }
   937→        try:
   938→            await manager.send_json("node.heartbeat", payload)
   939→        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
   940→            return
   941→
   942→    async def _publish_heartbeat_product_reports(self) -> None:
   943→        """Forward any newly produced heartbeat summaries to IM as user-visible reports.
   944→
   945→        Notes:
   946→            Heartbeat scheduling itself stays local to the gateway process. This bridge only
   947→            ships already-prepared report payloads into the existing IM `node.report` path so
   948→            the result becomes visible in the same product conversation surface as normal relay
   949→            work.
   950→        """
   951→        manager = self._im_connection_manager
   952→        runner = self._heartbeat_runner
   953→        if manager is None or not manager.connected or runner is None:
   954→            return
   955→        build_reports = getattr(runner, "build_product_reports", None)
   956→        if build_reports is None:
   957→            return
   958→        for payload in build_reports():
   959→            try:
   960→                await manager.send_json("node.report", payload)
   961→            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
   962→                return

  1014→def launch_gateway_in_background(
  1015→    *,
  1016→    config_path: str | Path,
  1017→    load_config: Callable[[str | Path], LocalConfig] = load_local_config,
  1018→    spawn_process: BackgroundProcessFactory | None = None,
  1019→    wait_for_ready: ReadyWaiter | None = None,
  1020→    im_service_url_override: str | None = None,
  1021→) -> BackgroundLaunchResult:
  1022→    """Start the gateway in a detached child and wait until it is ready.
  1023→
  1024→    Args:
  1025→        config_path: Operator-provided config path forwarded to the detached child.
  1026→        load_config: Config loader used to resolve health-check details before spawning.
  1027→        spawn_process: Optional detached-child launcher override used by tests.
  1028→        wait_for_ready: Optional readiness waiter override used by tests.
  1029→
  1030→    Returns:
  1031→        Detached process metadata once the child reaches ready state.
  1032→
  1033→    Raises:
  1034→        RuntimeError: When the detached child exits or never becomes ready.
  1035→    """
  1036→
  1037→    config = _load_runtime_config(
  1038→        config_path,
  1039→        load_config=load_config,
  1040→        im_service_url_override=im_service_url_override,
  1041→    )
  1042→    # Single-instance protection: refuse to start if a live gateway is already running.
  1043→    existing_pid = _read_gateway_pid(config)
  1044→    if existing_pid is not None:
  1045→        if _pid_is_running(existing_pid):
  1046→            raise GatewayStartupError(
  1047→                summary=f"gateway is already running (pid={existing_pid})",
  1048→                next_step=f"Run 'stop' to shut it down first, or 'restart' to replace it.",
  1049→            )
  1050→        # Stale PID file from a crashed process — clean it up and continue.
  1051→        _remove_gateway_pid(config)
  1052→    log_path = _default_gateway_log_path(config)
  1053→    log_offset = log_path.stat().st_size if log_path.exists() else 0
  1054→    argv = _background_gateway_argv(config.source_path, im_service_url_override=im_service_url_override)
  1055→    launcher = spawn_process or _spawn_background_gateway_process
  1056→    ready_waiter = wait_for_ready or _wait_for_gateway_ready
  1057→    process = launcher(argv, log_path)
  1058→    try:
  1059→        ready_waiter(process, config, config.kernel.startup_timeout_seconds)
  1060→    except Exception as exc:
  1061→        _stop_background_process(process, timeout_seconds=config.kernel.shutdown_grace_seconds)
  1062→        hint = _read_log_last_error(log_path, offset=log_offset)
  1063→        summary = hint if hint else str(exc)
  1064→        raise GatewayStartupError(
  1065→            summary=summary,
  1066→            next_step=f"Check the log for details: tail -20 {log_path}",
  1067→        ) from exc
  1068→    result = BackgroundLaunchResult(
  1069→        pid=process.pid,
  1070→        health_url=f"{config.kernel.base_url}{config.kernel.health_path}",
  1071→        log_path=log_path,
  1072→        im_service_url=config.im_service.url if config.im_service is not None else None,
  1073→    )
  1074→    _write_gateway_state(config, result)
  1075→    return result

  1078→def stop_gateway(
  1079→    *,
  1080→    config_path: str | Path,
  1081→    load_config: Callable[[str | Path], LocalConfig] = load_local_config,
  1082→) -> str:
  1083→    """Stop the background gateway associated with one config path.
  1084→
  1085→    Args:
  1086→        config_path: Operator-provided config path used to resolve the runtime state file.
  1087→        load_config: Config loader used to derive the state file and shutdown timing.
  1088→
  1089→    Returns:
  1090→        One operator-facing status line describing stop success, not-running, stale state, or
  1091→        a remaining listener that still answers on the same health URL.
  1092→
  1093→    Side Effects:
  1094→        Sends SIGTERM and possibly SIGKILL to the background gateway process and removes stale state.
  1095→    """
  1096→
  1097→    config = load_config(config_path)
  1098→    state_path = _gateway_state_path(config)
  1099→    state = _read_gateway_state(state_path)
  1100→    if state is None:
  1101→        pid = _read_gateway_pid(config)
  1102→        if pid is None:
  1103→            return f"NOT RUNNING config={config.source_path.name} state={state_path}"
  1104→        if not _pid_is_running(pid):
  1105→            _remove_gateway_pid(config)
  1106→            return f"STALE pid={pid} pid_file={_gateway_pid_path(config)}"
  1107→        try:
  1108→            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
  1109→        except ProcessLookupError:
  1110→            _remove_gateway_pid(config)
  1111→            return f"STALE pid={pid} pid_file={_gateway_pid_path(config)}"
  1112→        deadline = time.monotonic() + config.kernel.shutdown_grace_seconds
  1113→        while time.monotonic() <= deadline:
  1114→            if not _pid_is_running(pid):

class GatewayStartupError(RuntimeError):
    """Represent one actionable startup failure shown to gateway operators.

    Args:
        summary: Human-readable failure summary.
        next_step: Optional concrete remediation step shown alongside the error.
    """

    def __init__(self, *, summary: str, next_step: str | None = None) -> None:
        cleaned_summary = summary.strip()
        cleaned_next_step = next_step.strip() if isinstance(next_step, str) and next_step.strip() else None
        super().__init__(cleaned_summary)
        self.summary = cleaned_summary
        self.next_step = cleaned_next_step


def _read_log_last_error(log_path: Path, *, offset: int = 0, lines: int = 20) -> str | None:
    """Return the last non-empty line written after *offset* bytes, or None if unreadable."""
    try:
        with log_path.open("rb") as f:
            f.seek(offset)
            chunk = f.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        tail = [l for l in chunk.splitlines()[-lines:] if l.strip()]
        return tail[-1] if tail else None
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None


def _check_im_reachable(url: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if the IM service HTTP endpoint responds within 1 second."""
    try:
        httpx.get(url, timeout=1.0, trust_env=False)
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False


def _print_gateway_started(result: "BackgroundLaunchResult") -> None:
    print(f"Gateway started  (pid={result.pid})")
    print(f"Health:          {result.health_url}")
    if result.im_service_url is not None:
        reachable = _check_im_reachable(result.im_service_url)
        status = "connected" if reachable else "unavailable (running offline, will retry)"
        print(f"IM service:      {result.im_service_url}  [{status}]")
    print(f"Log:             {result.log_path}")


def _emit_gateway_feedback(level: str, summary: str, next_step: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Print one operator-facing gateway feedback line to stderr."""

    if level == "ERROR":
        print("Gateway failed to start\n", file=sys.stderr)
        for line in summary.splitlines():
            print(f"  {line}", file=sys.stderr)
        if next_step is not None:
            print(f"\n  → {next_step}", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(f"{level} {summary}", file=sys.stderr)
        if next_step is not None:
            print(f"  → {next_step}", file=sys.stderr)


class GatewayRuntimeLike(Protocol):
    """Describe the minimal lifecycle contract used by `run_gateway`."""

    def run_forever(self) -> int:
        """Run the gateway until shutdown and return the process exit code."""


class HeartbeatRunner(Protocol):
    """Describe the async lifecycle expected from the heartbeat runner wrapper."""

    async def start(self) -> None:
        """Start background scheduler ticking."""

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Stop background scheduler ticking and wait for drain."""

    def build_product_reports(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        """Return IM-facing heartbeat report payloads ready for `node.report`.

        Returns:
            Report payloads that should be forwarded to IM after heartbeat work has produced
            a user-visible result. Implementations may return an empty list when there is
            nothing new to publish.
        """


class IMConnectionManagerLike(Protocol):
    """Describe the async lifecycle required from the optional IM connector."""

    async def connect_once(self) -> None:
        """Establish the initial websocket connection and register the node."""

    async def run_forever(self) -> None:
        """Keep the websocket alive until close is requested."""

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the websocket and stop reconnect attempts."""


class BrowserOpener(Protocol):
